name: tool-interaction-mvp
title: Tool Interaction MVP 工具选择与使用
description: 实现 Hotbar 选择、手持物表现和所选物品驱动的世界交互；新游戏直接配发基础斧头、锄头、浇水壶，删除木斧制作占位。
creator: fable
notes: Implemented selected Hotbar item ownership across Vue, Phaser and GameSession: default empty hand, click/1-8 toggle, held item projection, exact axe/tree and farm item/phase pairs, quiet wrong-tool actions, code-driven empty-hand harvest, starter axe/hoe/watering can, and removal of the wooden-axe UI placeholder. User explicitly waived further manual validation and accepted the slice. Automated evidence: Life Loop 8/8, Town/selection 3/3, typecheck and client build passed. No save migration or old-content compatibility was added.
